description:
Read a spec file from the specs directory.

Tests are only generated from an approved plan: a plan that is still a draft (Status: draft) is refused until the user
has reviewed and approved it (planner_approve_plan).

specFile.description: Spec or test plan to read: a path, or just its name in specs/ (e.g. "shopping-cart" or "shopping-cart.md")

name: generator_read_spec
